ruleText: Ordinary wolves become territorial instead of hunting: a warning band at 2500 units - bear parity, since vanilla EncBear is 2500/2000/1500 and vanilla EncWolf has no warning band at all - warn-or-attack at 1200, and attack at 640 instead of 1500. 640 is the vanilla horker warn-or-attack distance; the horker, the other actor the user named, attacks at 320. 1 unit = 1.428 cm, so a wolf now attacks at about 9 m instead of 21 m and growls from about 36 m. Aggression stays Unaggressive and the flanking combat style (csWolf, DATA flag 0x2, FlankDistance 0.5, StalkTime 0.4) is untouched, so a pack still behaves like a pack. User design 2026-09-02 on #42; measurements in the 2026-09-02 appendix of docs/WILDLIFE-WOLVES-2026-08-28.md.
